phone_checklist: Tune every string with deliberate sharp/flat offsets, then let it decay. Check octave stability.
Run tuner for 10 minutes including sustained voice; switch guitar/chromatic and selected octaves.
Lock/unlock, background/return and interrupt audio. Check recovery and microphone release.
Listen to slow/fast rhythms, rapidly switch previews, verify up/down pattern and F/E chords without clicks.
Preview different fingerings and use capo/transposition; compare sounding pitches with diagrams.
Create/edit a song with cover, restart, verify favorites and reading/rhythm settings.
Export backup, preview/restore, verify covers and settings; cancellation must preserve existing data.
Record while auto-scrolling; replay/export/delete. Check loud and quiet performances. Recordings are not in library backup.
Deny microphone permission, then enable it in device settings. Test offline mode.
Check portrait/landscape, large text and keyboard on a small phone. No overlap or unreachable controls.
When accounts exist, verify purchases, cancellation, pending state and recovery through store sandbox.

On macOS install pods, select signing team, build/archive, verify Privacy Report/SDK manifests and run test-ios-pitch.py plus microphone/recording tests.
Register identifier com.freetune or change identifiers consistently if unavailable. Configure consumable freetune_support, taxes, pricing and tester access.

signing.note: Keep key/password backed up privately. Never upload the password file with store materials. RC5 sideload APK uses debug signing and cannot be updated directly with a differently signed build; export data before changing installation channel.
